title: Scale coordination uses Plan and bounded Work authority
userIntent: Coordinate independent Scale slices through an approved Plan and existing Work/Process/resource-claim authorities without inventing a second lifecycle.

intendedBehavior: Explicit Scale requires an approved Plan step.
Independent Plan steps are admitted as independent bounded Work units.
Stopping Scale units projects lifecycle state through the same Plan/Work authority.
behavioralInvariants: Scale is coordination, not an agent swarm.
Independent deliverables may run concurrently when resource claims do not conflict.
Plan and Work remain the only project-level semantic lifecycle authorities.
regressionRisks: Creating a second scheduler or project lifecycle.
Collapsing independent Plan steps into one unrelated Work authority.

provenance.note: Final exact-main convergence acceptance scenario added by Plan S4; the immutable snapshot is the S3-integrated main revision.
